existingRecords.title: The object-pose queries the placement path uses: GetZRotatedPointAboveObjectCenter, GetClosestMarkerPose and the Radians comparisons
existingRecords.effect: a placement or a marker choice differs by a frame or a boundary case
existingRecords.provenance: recovered by the R-VIS M12 gap pass 2; the C# ObjectPoseQueries default throws
existingRecords.authority: libcozmoEngine.so 3.4.0-1204 (re-analysis/research/20260929-R-VIS-M12-gap2-extraction.md Q1-Q3, verified in re-analysis/research/20260929-R-VIS-verify-M12-gap2.md): GetZRotatedPointAboveObjectCenter(f) 0x00877574: L = the object's pose re-expressed against FindRoot (via 0x004DF628; failure logs 'Could not get pose w.r.t. its own root'); dimZ = GetDimInParentFrame<'Z'> (0x00557794; axis +-3 -> size.z, +-2 -> size.y, else size.x, via vtable +0x2C); yaw = GetAngleAroundZaxis(L); T = (this.pose.x, this.pose.y, L.z + dimZ*f) (x, y are the object's own un-converted values); result Pose3d(yaw, Z_AXIS, T, parent = root); f multiplies the extent (0 = centre, 0.5 = top face); only yaw is kept. GetClosestMarkerPose 0x00877774: copies list<KnownMarker> from this+0x28, requires GetWithRespectTo(markerPose, pose) == 1, distance planar (x^2+y^2) when the flag is 1 else 3-D, strictly smaller wins from 0x7F7FFFFF, stores the marker code with strh, returns 0 (else 0x06000000); the input marker is never read. Radians: rescale 0x0084C87C range (-pi, pi], NaN passes through; IsNear 0x0084CC0A is a strict < on the rescaled difference, the tolerance's sign ignored, NaN false; operator> 0x0084CC90 = diff > 0 and !IsNear(1e-5 = 0x3727C5AC); GetAngleAroundZaxis 0x0084AA1C picks atan2f(R10,R00) if R10^2+R00^2 > R01^2+R11^2 else atan2f(-R01,R11)
evidence: re-analysis/research/20260929-R-VIS-M12-gap2-extraction.md Q1-Q3; re-analysis/research/20260929-R-VIS-verify-M12-gap2.md Q1-Q3 (PASS). Caveat: x, y are parent-frame values while z and yaw are root-relative, and the parent is set to root: consistent only when the object's parent is the root
existingRecords.unresolved: Built: EngineRadians (Rescale 0x0084C87C, IsNear 0x0084CC0A strict/wrap-aware/|tol|, GetAngleAroundZaxis 0x0084AA1C) and ObjectPoseQueries.Engine (GetZRotatedPointAboveObjectCenter 0x00877574, GetClosestMarkerPose 0x00877774); the throwing default is gone and PreActionPose.cs:389's <= is now the strict compare. Still open, so the record stays IMPLEMENTATION_GAP: the C# has no pose tree, so the root re-expression and the frame mixing of GetZRotatedPointAboveObjectCenter (parent x, y with root-relative z and yaw) coincide and the caveat cannot show; the axis choice of GetDimInParentFrame<'Z'> reuses CubeGeometry.DimInParentFrameZ (M12-012's reading) where M12-033's text selects by GetRotatedParentAxis' signed axis (identical for a 44 mm cube); the float bit patterns of the four pi constants are taken to be the standard floats (the report gives their addresses); operator> (0x0084CC90) is not built (no C# consumer beyond DistanceThresholdMm's existing 1e-5 guard). Pose3d read 2026-10-13 (re-analysis/research/20261013-pose3d-arithmetic.md): the arithmetic is M11-065, the tree M11-066, unread pieces M11-067. The GetAngleAroundZaxis entries are computed in f64 and narrowed to f32 before the squares (R14).

existingRecords.title: GetAbsoluteHeadAngleToLookAtPose and Robot::ComputeHeadAngleToSeePose
existingRecords.effect: a face-fine-tune or pan-and-tilt head angle differs from the engine's
existingRecords.provenance: recovered by the R-VIS M13 gap pass 3; the C# TurnTowardsPose.HeadAngleToSee is LOCAL numerics
existingRecords.authority: libcozmoEngine.so 3.4.0-1204 (re-analysis/research/20260929-R-VIS-M13-gap3-extraction.md Q3, verified in re-analysis/research/20260929-R-VIS-verify-M13-gap3.md Q3): TurnTowardsPoseAction::GetAbsoluteHeadAngleToLookAtPose 0x0054B428: h = z + (-49.0) (0xC2440000); d = sqrt(x*x + y*y) (float vsqrt, NaN falls back to sqrtf); D = d + 13.0; a = (300.0 - D)/150.0 (0x43960000, 0x43160000); b = (0.0 - h)/-10.0; t1 = clamp01(a) * 0.0872664601 (5 degrees) and t2 = clamp01(b) * 0.130899698 (7.5 degrees) (0 for <=0 or NaN, the value for 0<x<1, 1 for >=1); A = atan2f(h, D); result = ((t2 + (A + t1)) + 0.0698131695 (4 degrees, 0x3D8EFA35)) as Radians. Robot::ComputeHeadAngleToSeePose 0x00518344: GetWithRespectTo(pose, robot+0x2CC) failing -> warning and 0x06000000; p = (sqrt(tx*tx+ty*ty), 0, tz); the camera copied from [robot+0x258]+0x24, a null calibration -> error and 1; tol = (float)calibration.nrows * f + 9.99999975e-06; theta = 0, index 1; each iteration: camPose = Robot::GetCameraPose(theta), inv = camPose.GetInverse(), q = T.rotation * p + T.translation; if not q.z > 1e-5f -> 'BadProjectedZ' warning and 1; dv = calibration.focal_y * (q.y/q.z); converged iff tol >= |dv| (writes headAngle = theta via Radians::operator=(float), returns 0 unless the index is 25 -> 'MaxIterations' warning and 1); else theta += -0.8f * atan2f(dv, focal_y); after 25 non-converged iterations the code returns 0 (success) WITHOUT writing headAngle (r0 = 26 passes the 'cmp r0,#0x19; bne' test). Confirmed by reading (register trace) in the verifier; not emulated
existingRecords.unresolved: Settled (Claude check, 2026-10-27; re-analysis/research/20261027-pickup-stack-1-claude-check.md; PICKUP-STACK-1 merge): both bodies match the binary. ComputeHeadAngleToSeePose (VisionSystem.cs native overload, actual live MAIN neck parent): BadProjectedZ is vcmpe/bls 0x00518494 (NaN q.z continues, not 'not q.z > 1e-5' as the authority text says); convergence vcmpe/bge 0x005184B2 (NaN dv iterates); the angle is written through Radians::operator= 0x005185B6 BEFORE the k==25 MaxIterations test 0x005185C6; 25 non-converged iterations return 0 without writing; step atan2f(dv, fy) * -0.8f 0x005184BC..0x005184DA. GetAbsoluteHeadAngleToLookAtPose 0x0054B428..0x0054B55A (PanAndTiltActions.cs AbsoluteHeadAngleToLookAtPose): every it-pl/it-gt pick and its flag source, the sqrtf NaN fallback and the operation order match. Boundary: only the bionic atan2f (0x004A4510) and sqrtf fallback are EQUIVALENT_IMPLEMENTATION (unshipped system library, M13-023 (e), as M5-021/M4-052); operands, widths and order are exact. Pose algebra is the native Transform3d port (M11-065 rows); the public flat-input static adapter is M11-066's labelled gap, not this record's path.
